steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the vendor bid already present.
Enable eRFX projects for the RFQ scenario.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required in-bidding rejection configuration.
Allow buyer bid-field editing as required by the case configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case configuration.
Open the Price Trends tab from the RFQ event.
Assert that the Price Trends view rendered its product content.
Verify that opening Price Trends did not produce an application error.
